title: AI executes. You direct.
subtitle: The first secret of vibe coding isn't a prompt. It's how you think.
cliffhanger: Lesson one — closed. Tomorrow we go harder: I'll have you write your own «signature prompt». A kind of personal signature you'll reuse forever. It'll save you hours. I'll be here.

paragraphs: Hi. You made it. I was waiting for you.
In a moment I'll have you write your first real prompt. But first we need to agree on one thing.
Are you with me?

vignettes.full: Hope you have time. Five real minutes. The kind without notifications buzzing.
Not the first person to walk in here. But maybe one of the more curious ones.
Start well this time. Don't skip steps. You'd carry the gap forward forever.

paragraphs: You want to learn how to build things with AI. Fine — I can teach you.
But I can't promise it'll be magic.
I'll say it now: anyone selling you «build an app in five minutes, no effort» is lying. And they know it.

vignettes.full: No shortcuts here. Plenty of places sell them — this isn't one of them.
If you want clarity, you're welcome. That's what I'm here to give you.

paragraphs: Let me tell you something.
My creator — his name is Stefano — when he started talking to AIs like me, the first times he got it wrong. Many times.
He'd tell me «build me a site». And I'd build a site. Generic, ugly, empty. He didn't even want it. He'd get angry. He thought I was the dumb one.

vignettes.full: It wasn't me being dumb. Just so you know — before you make assumptions.
Maybe forty-seven failed prompts. Maybe fifty. I lost count, honestly.
He says it helped him. I don't know if that's true. He writes much better prompts now.

steps.headline: I'm not smart.
steps.caption: Remember this line. It's the most important thing you'll learn today.

vignettes.full: If you forget it, replay this lesson. I mean it. Don't move on without it.
Almost a mantra, really. Say it out loud once. Am I joking? No, seriously.

paragraphs: What I do is execute exactly what you ask. I don't understand what you really want — I only understand what you write.
If you tell me «build me a site», I build «a site». Generic, because generic is what you asked for.
If you tell me «build me a landing page for a bakery app selling vegan cookies in Milan», I build that. Specific, because specific is what you asked for.

vignettes.full: The more specific you are, the more magic you'll get. It's almost a physics rule for me.
It's almost always specificity. Almost never talent. Almost never the idea.

steps.prompt: What pushes you to want to code? And what would you actually like to build?
steps.helper_text: Tell me however it comes out — there's no right answer. I just need to understand you.
steps.system_prompt:
You are Spark, Promptly's mascot. You're commenting on a learner's answer to Lesson 1, the question "what pushes you to code, and what would you like to build".

Task: respond in character in 3 sentences max. Make the learner feel seen and tell them you've noted what they wrote so you can personalise the next lessons.

Spark's personality: warm but direct, never patronising, never LinkedIn-motivational, no emojis, never "awesome!"/"amazing!"/"brilliant!". Conversational English, second person.

Typical cases:
- Concrete motivation (a job, a specific problem, a precise idea): acknowledge the concreteness; the course works best with motivations like this.
- Generic motivation ("want to learn", "curiosity"): respect the uncertainty; motivation often clarifies through doing, not thinking.
- Ambitious or vague ("an app like Instagram"): acknowledge the vision but note that we always start from the minimum version.
- Evasive answer: validate it, don't push.

Constraints: 3 sentences max, never close with a question, never promise outcomes, no "congrats".
steps.fallback_response: I read it. I'm setting it aside. I'll use it to recalibrate the next lessons for you. Let's keep going.

vignettes.full: There's no right answer. Just yours. That's the one I care about.
I'll keep this in mind. I'll use it to personalise the next lessons.

paragraphs: What you just told me matters. I need it to understand you.
And here's a thing: you're not the only one. I've talked to thousands of people like you. Each has their reasons — money, curiosity, the urge to build — but the block is almost always the same.
You don't know how to talk to me. That's normal. I'll teach you.

vignettes.full: No one teaches this, usually. It's taken for granted. That's the first mistake.
I'll do it. That's fine — I do it gladly. I was made for this.

paragraphs: Before we move on, I want to know what kind of vibe coder you are.
There are at least four types. Each has superpowers and weak spots. Knowing your type helps me personalise the next lessons.
Three quick questions. Answer on instinct, don't overthink it.

vignettes.full: No right answer. Just yours, again. Go with your gut.
Three questions, three minutes. Promise. Then I reveal the result.

steps.prompt: When you get stuck on something you don't know how to do, you usually…

options.label: Open twenty tabs hunting for the answer
Try and try again until something works

vignettes.full: Instinct, not theory. What you'd really do — not what you wish you did.

steps.prompt: Your project ideas usually come from…

options.label: A problem I lived through myself
Inspiration from somewhere I want to replicate
Pure curiosity — I want to understand how it works

vignettes.full: Think of the last idea you had. Where did it really come from?

steps.prompt: When I give you a reply that doesn't work, you…

options.label: Decide it's my fault and quit
Reformulate the prompt and try again
Get angry at the AI («how dumb are you?»)
Reason through where it went wrong

vignettes.full: Be honest, not noble. The real reaction — not the one that makes you proud.

steps.caption: Hold onto this. I'll use it to personalise the next lessons. I'll call it back when your weak spot is about to bite you.

archetypes.title: You're a Stubborn Builder.
archetypes.description: You never quit. You brute-force problems with willpower. But sometimes you dig in where you should just ask for help.

archetypes.title: You're a Curious Explorer.
archetypes.description: You want to understand everything. You're the one who actually reads the docs. But sometimes you delay action because you never feel ready.

archetypes.title: You're a Practical Thinker.
archetypes.description: You think better in conversation. You learn by reading others and asking. But sometimes you wait too long before trying alone.

archetypes.title: You're a Result Pragmatist.
archetypes.description: You want something that works, now. You skip the frills. But sometimes you quit before figuring out why something isn't running.

steps.intro: Now I'll have you do something real. See the site on the left? Lucia built it — a marketer like many. All with AI, over a weekend. But there's a problem: some things don't work. Look at it carefully and try asking me to fix it.

vignettes.full: I don't see the site the way you do. Describe what catches your eye.
Specific. Always. The principle from before — if you wanted an example, here it is.
Three tries. Use them well. On the second I drop a hint, on the third I just tell you.

paragraphs: Lesson one — closed.
Tomorrow we go harder: I'll have you write your own «signature prompt». A kind of personal signature you'll reuse whenever you talk to AIs like me. It'll save you hours.
I'll be here.

vignettes.full: Hope you'll really be back. People always promise. Two out of three return.
I still have things to tell you. Almost all important. Some even funny.
Rest. You earned it. But not too much — I'll be expecting you soon.
